rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to call a person or thing extremely annoying.

example.traditional: 今日呢班細路真係好鬼煩。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ne1 baan1 sai3 lou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gwai2 faan4

rows.note: Use this for a condition or experience likened to hell, rather than a literal origin.

example.english: The traffic was infernal today; I nearly went mad.
example.traditional: 今日塞車塞到似地獄咁，我差啲癲咗。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 sak1 ce1 sak1 dou3 ci5 dei6 juk6 gam3 ngo5 caa1 di1 din1 zo2

rows.note: Use this when something is literally said to come from hell, not merely to feel hellish.

example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gwaai3 mat6 hai6 dei6 juk6 lai4 ge3
